title: Stop an EC2 instance
description: Stops one EC2 instance by instance id via the native stop lifecycle operation.

outputs.name: currentState
outputs.description: State the instance is transitioning to (stopping)

outputs.name: previousState
outputs.description: State the instance was in before the call

notes: The call is asynchronous: it returns when the instance enters the stopping state, not when it is stopped. Poll aws/ec2/instances-by-region until instanceState.name is stopped. The matching start operation is aws.ec2.instances.start with the same arguments.
